addon.name: Skin NikeFlix
addon.provider-name: NikeFlix (based on Titan by marcelveldt, Titan BINGIE by cartman.dos, Titan BINGIE MOD by AchillesPunks & Matke)

extension.description: Skin NikeFlix is the NikeFlix home-theatre skin for Kodi Omega. It is a modified version of Titan BINGIE MOD 2.2.8 (AchillesPunks & Matke), which is based on Titan BINGIE (cartman.dos) and Titan (marcelveldt). Licensed under GPL-2.0-only; see NOTICE.md and CREDITS.md.
extension.news: [B]Skin NikeFlix 1.3.5 (NikeFlix 4.1.7)[/B][CR]Title page: Resume and Play first, the rest under More..., full-screen art, and after Stop you are back on it. Skipping Intro shows when an intro is skipped. No pop-up notices.[CR][CR][B]Skin NikeFlix 1.3.4 (NikeFlix 4.1.6)[/B][CR]Choose a profile: nothing cut off on the left, a white outline round the focused profile. Home opens with the first row already showing big. No black card while moving along a row. Notices as a small bar at the bottom.[CR][CR][B]Skin NikeFlix 1.3.3 (NikeFlix 4.1.5)[/B][CR]Loading screen, Skip Intro, Next Episode, Still Watching and Netflix-style subtitles.
